disclaimer: DEMO VALUES for the Benki Yetu simulation. These are not real limits, charges or timings of any bank.

topics.answer: PesaLink sends money to an account at another Kenyan bank instantly, 24/7. Demo limits: KES 10 to KES 999,999 per transaction. Demo charges: KES 0-500: free; 501-10,000: KES 45; 10,001-100,000: KES 90; above 100,000: KES 180.

Bank to M-Pesa sends money to any Safaricom number instantly. Demo limits: KES 10 to KES 250,000 per transaction, KES 500,000 per day. Demo charges: up to KES 1,000: KES 15; 1,001-10,000: KES 35; above 10,000: KES 55.

Lipa na M-Pesa pays a Buy Goods till or a Paybill (business number plus your account number at that business) instantly. Demo limit: KES 250,000 per transaction. Demo charge: free for you; the merchant pays.
Transfers between Benki Yetu accounts (your own or another customer's) are instant and free, 24/7. Demo limit: KES 1,000,000 per transaction.
RTGS is for large, same-day transfers to other banks. Demo values: minimum KES 1,000,001, charge KES 500, same day if sent before 3:00 pm on a working day, otherwise next working day.
EFT sends to other banks through clearing. Demo values: charge KES 100, arrives in 1-2 working days, no upper limit.

You can send money from your Benki Yetu account to another Benki Yetu account (instant, free), to another bank via PesaLink (instant) or RTGS/EFT (larger amounts, slower), to an M-Pesa number, or pay a till/paybill. Ask about any of them for limits, charges and timings.
